criteria.description: Fresh graphs contain useful timestamped lifecycle events; changes are ordered, deduplicated, and bounded.
Observed flows emit no fabricated edges and explain unavailable relationships; custom topology remains exact.
Existing polling is reused, unchanged polls do not publish, and retained observation state is bounded.
Protocol, presence, historical routing, workspace isolation, and all sibling skills remain unchanged.
Browser and current-workspace runtime evidence clearly distinguish observed from declared topology and show event recency.
